title: Modern Node.js Patterns for 2025
summary: Comprehensive guide to contemporary Node.js development covering ES Modules with node: prefix, built-in Fetch API and AbortController, native test runner, Worker Threads, and integrated tooling features like --watch and --env-file that reduce external dependencies.
when-to-read: Read this article when modernizing a Node.js codebase or learning current best practices for JavaScript server-side development in 2025. If you need to evaluate specific dependencies (like HTTP clients, test frameworks, or environment loaders), consult articles on dependency management or code-quality instead.
